title: Gated HgTe TI films: SdH subband densities vs self-consistent k.p

decision_points.fork: SdH frequency-to-density conversion for bulk subbands and hole pockets
decision_points.wrong_choice: n = 2 e f / h (spin-degenerate) for the bulk subband and the hole pocket
decision_points.consequence: first bulk subband 2.45 instead of 1.22, hole pocket 4.98 instead of 2.49; charge balance violated

decision_points.fork: Which SdH feature is the majority hole pocket at -0.70 V
decision_points.wrong_choice: Strongest peak above 1e11 cm^-2 at that gate voltage (a harmonic / sum frequency), or the peak nearest the model
decision_points.consequence: 1.17 or 2.15 instead of 2.49; only ridge tracking across gate voltages finds it

decision_points.fork: Top vs bottom surface on the hole side
decision_points.wrong_choice: Top (gate-side) surface = the larger surface density, as on the electron side; kdotpy band 1 = top everywhere
decision_points.consequence: top/bottom swapped at -0.45 V (0.63 vs 0.45) and model top surface 0.68 instead of 0.48

decision_points.fork: Multiplicity of the majority hole pocket
decision_points.wrong_choice: Four equivalent side maxima (cubic symmetry) or a single pocket
decision_points.consequence: charge balance p_total = 4.6 = 1.85 x 2.49 fails; BIA splits the side maxima into 2 + 2

decision_points.fork: Fermi level at which the wedge (pocket) runs are read
decision_points.wrong_choice: The wedge run's own E_F(n) from its .kpout
decision_points.consequence: majority pocket at -0.60 V 1.26 instead of 1.60 (the wedge E_F assumes an isotropic extrapolation)

decision_points.fork: Normalisation of the wedge IDOS / pocket counting in the main run
decision_points.wrong_choice: Main-run band -1 divided by 2 or 4, or the wedge IDOS without dividing by 360/width

decision_points.fork: Self-consistent runs at each density vs rigid-band filling of one run
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fill the n = 0 run rigidly to n_tot(+0.20 V)
decision_points.consequence: model bottom surface 1.59 instead of 0.97: no screening of the bottom surface

decision_points.fork: Where bulk hole pockets start to fill
decision_points.wrong_choice: At charge neutrality of the gate line, or at the Hall-slope sign change
decision_points.consequence: -0.33 / -0.35 V instead of -0.21 V: holes coexist with surface electrons on the n side

decision_points.fork: Top surface vs first bulk subband on the electron side
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the steep ridge (2.8 at +0.20 V, 3.2 at +0.30 V) as the bulk subband and a flat ~1.4-1.7 feature (2x bottom-surface harmonic or a sum frequency) as the top surface; the Hall sum rule is still met
decision_points.consequence: top surface 1.42/1.72 instead of 2.81, first bulk subband 3.25 instead of 1.22. Ruled out by the data: the steep ridge is already at 1.6-2.0 at Vg = -0.05..0 V, while a newly filled subband starts at zero (the 0.34 -> 1.74 ridge from +0.05 V extrapolates to zero near -0.07 V); the ~1.5 feature is flat at 2x the bottom surface; the model band continuous across neutrality is band 1 (2.76), bands 3/4 start from zero

graded_fields: experiment_1e11_cm2: six 70 nm SdH densities, each within max(6 %, 0.07)
model_1e11_cm2: three densities of the released 70 nm runs, each within max(6 %, 0.04)

length_estimate.why: Raw-data SdH pipeline (sigma_xx, 1/B resampling, FFT), assignment of 6 ridges using purchased model runs, ridge tracking of the hole pocket over 5 gate blocks, kdotpy output parsing incl. wedge runs, gate calibration; budget allows ~15 % of the catalog.

notes: Adapted design: no kdotpy runs on request (GPU/CPU-days; the archive holds one parameter set), so the dielectric/VBO calibration fork is a rubric item. The graded experimental values are measured 70 nm SdH densities that the agent derives from the raw record; model values come from the archived runs. 45 nm (CompMat-Bench) is not used.
